articles.title: Polymarket users referred to prosecutors in South Korea: Report
articles.snippet: South Korean police reportedly referred 18 Polymarket users to prosecutors in a gambling probe involving 26 people and $12.7 million in bets.

articles.title: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
articles.snippet: The legislation seeks to codify Trump’s Bitcoin reserve policy, locking up Bitcoin acquired through civil and criminal forfeiture for 20 years.

articles.title: USDT payments feature in Polish energy giant’s failed $230M oil deal: FT
articles.snippet: Tether’s USDT stablecoin was part of a failed oil trade that reportedly cost a Polish energy giant $230 million in late 2023.

articles.title: CLARITY Act could get another shot during lame-duck session, policy advocate says
articles.snippet: Digital Sovereignty Alliance managing director Adrian Wall said senators from both parties are considering another attempt to advance the crypto market structure bill before the current Congress ends.

articles.title: Wall Street Bets on Fed Rate Hike: Here's What It Means for Bitcoin, Bonds and Trump
articles.snippet: Nearly every major bank now expects the Fed to raise rates for the first time in three years. Markets have mostly priced it in, but the political fallout could run deeper than one hike.
